findings.finding: The plan introduces a live external integration (`pycontribs/jira` calling a DC instance) but specifies no error-handling strategy — no retry/backoff, no timeout, no circuit-breaker, and no observability (metric/log/trace) for the new call path. scenarios: DC instance is unreachable during reconciliation — adapter hangs with no timeout, blocking the reconciler loop indefinitely

findings.suggested_fix: In the ADR, add a section 'Operational contract for DC API calls' covering: (1) per-call timeout (recommended default: 30 s), (2) exponential backoff with a cap (e.g. 3 retries, max 120 s), (3) structured log at ERROR level on final failure including the HTTP status and `RemoteRef.instance`.
